prompt: Create an exceptionally polished 1600x1000 desktop UI mockup for Echo, an English Windows League of Legends clip recorder. Direction B: CUT ROOM. Warm light editing studio: bone white #f1efe9 background, deep ink text, muted forest-green controls, tiny coral event ticks. Spacious elegant native application window. NO browser, NO marketing page. At upper left a small abstract echo/play/bookmark icon and 'Echo'. Thin left navigation rail Library / Matches / Settings. Main upper area: large landscape paused gameplay video on LEFT taking 65 percent width, a right column titled 'Moments' with search, All Kills Assists Deaths filters, and a precise vertical list of four video thumbnails with selected 'River skirmish', duration, small event tags and date. Beneath the video a clean transport bar and simple clip trim strip with two handles, timecodes, and forest-green Export clip button. Along the bottom spanning most main width is a horizontal media contact sheet titled 'Today', with 5 compelling gameplay stills, small labels, selected item outlined forest. Top right tiny calm 'Waiting for League' indicator and Record settings. Modern editorial sans typography, strong typographic hierarchy, 1px dividers, exceptionally restrained shadows, all controls readable and comfortable. Use illustrative League gameplay scenes in the media areas. No fabricated performance stats, no charts or gauges, no gradients, no glass, no purple, no giant record button. Render a single complete application screen, no physical device.
description: Illustrative design mockup, not an application screenshot.
